changes.options: In ARAM and ARAM: Mayhem champion select, your options with the best first and a button to take any; every other champion below.
changes.rift: In Summoner's Rift champion select, every champion of your position.
changes.cards: Augment labels show even when OP.GG is slow to answer.
changes.flicker: Home, Build and Augments no longer flicker during a game.
changes.client: A steadier connection to the client as you sign in, and the phone link starts again if it could not.

builtWith: Made with Rust, Tauri and Svelte. The in-game overlay is native: no browser, almost no memory.
available: A new version is out: v{{version}}.
installHint: Xyra closes and opens the installer; your settings and games are kept.
